title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Security Deposit when Private Billing Resumes
content:
**Deposit desk reference, returns to private pay — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** A refundable security deposit of the security deposit days times the tier's daily rate in effect on the admission date is collected on a private-pay agreement at admission; on an agreement that records no conversion to another payer source, the additional deposit owed after a move to a room of another tier is figured by the additional-deposit rule, and on an agreement that records a conversion and is active again, the resumption deposit owed once private-pay billing resumes is figured by the resumption-deposit rule; every other deposit stays under the admission rule.

Within the deposit disposition days after discharge, or after conversion to a payer source for which no deposit may be held, the deposit is applied to the agreement's open balance and any remainder is refunded to the resident, the designated representative, or the estate after a death; where private-pay billing resumes on the agreement within those days and the deposit has not yet been disposed of, the deposit stays on the agreement and counts toward the resumption deposit, and only in that case.

The resumption deposit is paid into the agreement's security deposit by the resident or the representative; where it works out to zero, nothing is paid.

**What the figure waits on.** The resumption deposit is not worked out until the agreement carries the span re-charging the days after the other payer source's coverage ended.

## Payment tool: `pay_resumption_deposit_9c511f79`

**Capability.** Pays money into the refundable security deposit held on the private-pay admission agreement of a resident billed privately again whose stay another payer source covered in part: one deposit receipt for the amount paid by the chosen method, raising the agreement's security deposit balance by that amount; the receipt shows on the resident's ledger and the new deposit balance is returned.

**How it is invoked.** A customer-side tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over; the customer themselves — the resident or the representative — runs it, paying in person over their own account.

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `private_agreement_id` | The reference number of the resident's private-pay admission agreement, as read out by the business office from the agreement lookup (id) |
| `payment_method` | How the payer hands over the money, one of `ach` (an electronic transfer from the payer's bank account), `card` (a debit or credit card), `check` (a personal check), `certified_check` (a bank-certified or cashier's check), `money_order` (a money order), `deposit_application` (funds already held by the center as a security deposit and moved into this deposit, never new money from the payer) |
| `amount` | The deposit paid in USD, positive, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** On success: status "received", the deposit receipt's ledger reference number, the payment method, the amount and the agreement's security deposit balance once the receipt is booked. A zero or negative amount returns an error.
